A1.justification: Both complete, readable PDFs describe the same DynamicFormer study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and appendices support comparison, including matching content relocated between sections.

before.justification: v2 reports original intersection-number prediction experiments, activation comparisons, representation probes, causal interventions and appendix ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Sections 3–5 and the appendices.

M1.justification: The DRA formula, two-branch DynamicFormer architecture, positional processing, PNA pooling, register tokens, Talking Modalities objective and prediction procedure remain unchanged. The redrawn architecture diagram does not introduce a new component.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same synthetic recursive sequence and intersection-number task, with training through genus 13 and OOD evaluation at genera 14–17. No dataset, domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches throughout: the activation and KAN comparisons in Figure 1, ReLU/GLU/Snake baselines in Table 2, and Snake/DRA MLP baselines in Table 4 are retained.

E3.justification: The ID/OOD settings, marked-point ranges, evaluation metrics and probing/intervention procedures are unchanged. The synthetic experiment retains its 64/32-neuron hidden layers and training/testing intervals of 0–120 and 121–200.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the register-token/Talking Modalities ablation, Dilaton similarity analysis, asymptotic probes, modality interventions and PCA analysis. Renaming and relocating appendix sections introduces no additional analysis.

E5.justification: The rolling-window conformal procedure, 90% target coverage, empirical coverage and conformal-width reporting are unchanged. v2 Appendix E becomes v3 Appendix G; no new repeated-run, seed or significance-testing information appears.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 retain their numerical entries, and the experimental plots retain the same results. For example, Table 2 still reports DRA R² of 95.8 and conformal width of 3.42; subleading-term probe R² remains 0.98 versus 0.63 for nonlinear versus linear probes.

T1.justification: Section 2 adds the factor -(2i-1)!!/2 to the stated identification of Virasoro generators. The explicit one-dimensional quantum Airy example, including its differential operator and Airy-function solution in v2 Appendix A, Eqs. A.3–A.4, is removed. The main theorems and recursion remain.

C1.justification: The introduction slightly narrows the comparative claim about uncertainty estimation, changing 'a notably absent requirement' in prior literature to 'an often overlooked aspect.' The central claims about DRA, OOD prediction and learned mathematical structure remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the Dilaton similarities, nonlinear asymptotic encoding and causal roles of the input modalities are retained. The future-research discussion moves from the conclusion to Appendix A without substantive changes to applicability, limitations or proposed directions.

D1.justification: The tensor encoding, dimension cap, architecture and loss details remain the same. The existing code-repository footnote moves from v2 Appendix C to the v3 abstract; this does not establish newly available code or changed access.

R1.justification: v3 adds Andersen et al. (2024), The ABCD of topological recursion, to the quantum Airy background and modestly softens the uncertainty-estimation literature-gap claim. Other reference changes largely update metadata for existing works.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized wording and grammar edits, updates acknowledgments and publication headers, and moves the related-work overview and future directions into Appendices B and A. The remaining appendices are relabeled, while the overall exposition is largely retained.

P2.justification: Figure 5 is redrawn and enlarged with revised styling but the same architecture. Existing figures and tables are repositioned, Table 1 gains an overall caption, and some captions are polished. No experimental display is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves readability through clearer prose, a more legible architecture diagram and an explicit dimension definition in Eq. 2.6. Removing the worked Airy example reduces introductory detail, but the method and empirical evidence remain intact. The net gain is primarily presentational and limited.
